title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model . However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. These optimizations ensure our streamlined algorithmic design fully realizes its performance potential and practical latency benefits across varying hardware architectures. By combining these innovations, our pipeline achieves exceptional efficiency up to 30 × \times speedup and 20% memory saving , delivering up to 3.5 × \times faster-than-real-time generation on 8 × \times GB200 cloud nodes and less than 1-min fully memory-resident execution on DGX-Spark.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型正在迅速扩展，并展现出更强的生成能力。 在这些近期的进展中，MiniMax-H3 脱颖而出，成为一款功能强大、可用于实际生产环境的大规模开源模型。 然而，其 330 亿参数和多步迭代去噪过程带来了巨大的计算开销。 因此，在云端部署（如 NVIDIA-GB200）中，生成延迟阻碍了它们的实际生产应用；而在边缘设备（如 DGX-Spark）上，严格的内存限制则带来了更多挑战。 为了解决从云端到边缘设备的这些多样化硬件瓶颈，我们提出了一套全栈推理流程，将高效的算法设计与优化的算子实现相结合。 在算法层面，我们引入了一种跨分辨率的两阶段生成调度器，充分利用了扩散模型的逐步特性：早期的低分辨率步骤快速建立全局布局，而后期的高分辨率步骤则专注于局部和感知细节的优化。 这两个阶段通过一个经过训练的潜在空间到潜在空间的映射模块相连，从而完全消除了跨不同分辨率进行转换时计算成本高昂的 VAE 解码-再编码循环。 在算子实现方面，我们部署了一个递归自我改进（RSI）循环，用于搜索内核融合和内存布局，并同时评估延迟与数值一致性。 这些优化确保了我们的精简算法设计能够充分发挥其性能潜力，并在不同硬件架构上带来实际的延迟优势。 通过结合这些创新，我们的流程实现了卓越的效率，最高可达 30 × 倍的速度提升和 20% 的内存节省，在 8 × GB200 云端节点上实现了高达 3.5 × 倍于实时速度的生成能力，并在 DGX-Spark 上实现了完全驻留内存、执行时间不到 1 分钟的性能。

paragraphs.en: Driven by model and data scaling, video diffusion models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have achieved remarkable generative prowess, with recent open-source releases like MiniMax-H3 delivering production-grade quality [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Despite these advances, the model’s massive 33-billion parameter and the multi-step iterative denoising process [ 1 , 10 ] impose a severe computational burden. Furthermore, the specific bottlenecks encountered during inference vary drastically across different hardware platforms and deployment scenarios. In cloud environments, system throughput and generation cost act as the primary hurdles, ultimately determining the economic viability of the service. Conversely, edge deployments are tightly constrained by memory limits; exceeding the available HBM forces the system to cpu-offloading, precipitating a catastrophic collapse in inference latency. Since these hardware constraints, a single optimization strategy cannot solve both issues, making the overall optimization process much more difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型和数据规模扩大的推动下，视频扩散模型 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 已展现出卓越的生成能力，近期发布的开源模型如 MiniMax-H3 甚至达到了生产级质量 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 尽管取得了这些进展，但该模型高达 330 亿的参数以及多步迭代去噪过程 [ 1 , 10 ] 带来了巨大的计算负担。 此外，推理过程中遇到的具体瓶颈在不同硬件平台和部署场景中存在显著差异。 在云端环境中，系统吞吐量和生成成本是主要障碍，最终决定了服务的经济可行性。 相反，边缘部署则受到内存限制的严格约束；一旦可用 HBM 被耗尽，系统将被迫进行 CPU 卸载，导致推理延迟急剧恶化。 由于这些硬件限制，单一优化策略无法同时解决这两个问题，使得整体优化过程变得更为复杂。

paragraphs.en: The acceleration of diffusion models has relied on two distinct paradigms. The first is algorithmic acceleration, which inherently alters the generation process through methods such as reducing sampling steps [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] , caching denoising computation [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] , implementing sparse attention mechanisms [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] , or modifying generation resolutions [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] , which are often in a lossy manner. The second is system-level acceleration, which preserves the mathematical output while applying low-level system optimizations, such as kernel fusion, memory layout restructuring, and communication scheduling [ 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型的加速依赖于两种不同的范式。 第一种是算法级加速，它通过减少采样步数 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ]、缓存去噪计算 [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ]、实现稀疏注意力机制 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] 或修改生成分辨率 [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] 等方法，从本质上改变了生成过程，而这些方法通常会导致信息损失。 第二种是系统级加速，它在保持数学输出的同时，应用了底层系统优化技术，例如内核融合、内存布局重构和通信调度 [ 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ]。

paragraphs.en: In this report, we optimize the inference pipeline from two perspectives of algorithm and implementation. For algorithmic acceleration , we leverage a fundamental evolutionary property of diffusion models: early denoising steps determine the overall structural layout of the video, while later steps synthesize high-frequency fine details. Building on this, we design a cross-resolution two-stage generation pipeline tailored to maximize efficiency at each phase. The first stage operates at a low resolution to rapidly establish the global layout and structural skeleton. The second stage shifts to a high resolution to focus entirely on refining visual details. To seamlessly connect these stages, we train a feature mapping module that performs direct latent-to-latent translation, completely eliminating the latency and memory overhead of the traditional pixel-level decode-and-reencode cycle. For system-level implementation , we introduce a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop [ 34 ] to conduct iterative and verifiable optimization. Operating under strict correctness verification, this RSI loop automatically explores a massive search space encompassing kernel fusions, memory layouts, and communication boundaries. The automated search consistently uncovers and optimizes low-level compute and communication bottlenecks, delivering massive kernel-level speedups across a wide range of hardware platforms. These optimization realizes the practical latency benefits of our efficient inference pipeline across varying hardware architectures, while requiring less human effort.
paragraphs.zh: 在本报告中，我们从算法和实现两个角度对推理流程进行优化。 在算法加速方面，我们利用了扩散模型的一项基本演化特性：早期的去噪步骤决定了视频的整体结构布局，而后期步骤则负责合成高频的精细细节。 基于此，我们设计了一条跨分辨率的两阶段生成流程，专门用于最大化每个阶段的效率。 第一阶段以低分辨率运行，快速建立全局布局和结构框架。 第二阶段切换至高分辨率，完全专注于视觉细节的精修。 为了无缝连接这两个阶段，我们训练了一个特征映射模块，能够直接进行潜在空间到潜在空间的转换，彻底消除了传统像素级解码-再编码循环带来的延迟和内存开销。 在系统级实现方面，我们引入了一种递归自我改进（RSI）循环 [34]，以执行迭代且可验证的优化。 在严格的正确性验证下运行，该 RSI 循环会自动探索一个巨大的搜索空间，涵盖内核融合、内存布局和通信边界。 这种自动化搜索能够持续发现并优化底层的计算和通信瓶颈，从而在各种硬件平台上实现大规模的内核级加速。 这些优化在不同硬件架构上实现了我们高效推理流程的实际延迟优势，同时减少了人工干预。

paragraphs.en: The current landscape of generative video is defined by open, large-scale diffusion transformers. Prominent base models include the CogVideo family [ 37 , 8 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 5 ] and its successor HunyuanVideo 1.5 [ 6 ] , as well as Wan [ 7 ] , LongCat-Video [ 38 ] , SANA-Video [ 39 ] , Cosmos 3 [ 40 ] , and JoyAI-Echo [ 41 ] . This report specifically serves MiniMax-H3 [ 4 ] , a 33-billion parameter joint audio-video generator, alongside LTX-2.5 [ 9 ] and its predecessor LTX-2.3 [ 42 ] , which provide second-stage refinement. Our latent handoff combines spatial upsampling with a separate learned translation between the H3 and LTX VAE representations. The joint audio-video nature of MiniMax-H3 introduces a distinct serving challenge compared to vision-only models: the audio track must survive every optimization applied to the pipeline, not merely the visual frames.
paragraphs.zh: 当前生成式视频领域的格局由开放的大规模扩散变换器所定义。 主要的基模型包括 CogVideo 系列 [ 37 , 8 ]、HunyuanVideo [ 5 ] 及其后续版本 HunyuanVideo 1.5 [ 6 ]，以及 Wan [ 7 ]、LongCat-Video [ 38 ]、SANA-Video [ 39 ]、Cosmos 3 [ 40 ] 和 JoyAI-Echo [ 41 ]。 本报告专门针对 MiniMax-H3 [ 4 ]——一个拥有 330 亿参数的联合音频视频生成器，以及 LTX-2.5 [ 9 ] 及其前身 LTX-2.3 [ 42 ]（用于第二阶段优化）展开讨论。 我们的潜在空间交接方法将空间上采样与 H3 和 LTX VAE 表示之间独立的、经过学习的转换相结合。 MiniMax-H3 的联合音频视频特性使其在部署方面面临与纯视觉模型截然不同的挑战：音频轨道必须在整个处理流程的所有优化步骤中保持完整，而不仅仅是视觉帧。

paragraphs.en: To manage the computational complexity of high-resolution generation, cascaded and multi-resolution generation schedules are well-established recipes in the literature [ 27 , 29 ] . paragraphs.en: Inference acceleration for diffusion transformers generally operates across three primary levers. The first lever is sparse attention, which mitigates the quadratic scaling of sequence length in video generation. Recent approaches include Sparse VideoGen [ 21 ] and Sparse VideoGen2 [ 22 ] , trainable sparse attention (VSA) [ 23 ] , Sliding Tile Attention [ 24 ] , SpargeAttn [ 43 ] , XAttention [ 26 ] , Radial Attention [ 25 ] , DraftAttention [ 44 ] , and PISA [ 45 ] . Additionally, the SageAttention line of work [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] provides highly optimized attention backends. We leverage similar principles for our sparse attention implementation, detailed in Sec. 3.4 . The second lever involves caching mechanisms and techniques to reduce the number of effective steps, thereby limiting how much of the network is evaluated per step. Methods such as TeaCache [ 16 ] , EasyCache [ 17 ] , Pyramid Attention Broadcast [ 18 ] , TaylorSeer [ 19 ] , and Cache-DiT [ 20 ] exploit temporal redundancy. These step-reduction techniques are orthogonal to our two-stage schedule; while caching reduces computation within a fixed resolution trajectory, our schedule alters the resolution trajectory itself.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器的推理加速通常通过三个主要途径实现。 第一个途径是稀疏注意力机制，它能缓解视频生成中序列长度带来的二次方增长问题。 近期的方法包括 Sparse VideoGen [ 21 ] 和 Sparse VideoGen2 [ 22 ]、可训练的稀疏注意力（VSA）[ 23 ]、滑动瓦片注意力 [ 24 ]、SpargeAttn [ 43 ]、XAttention [ 26 ]、径向注意力 [ 25 ]、DraftAttention [ 44 ] 以及 PISA [ 45 ]。 此外，SageAttention 系列研究 [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] 提供了高度优化的注意力后端。 我们在稀疏注意力实现中采用了类似的原则，具体细节见第 3.4 节。 第二个途径涉及缓存机制和相关技术，用于减少有效步数，从而限制每一步中需要评估的網絡部分。 诸如 TeaCache [ 16 ]、EasyCache [ 17 ]、金字塔注意力广播 [ 18 ]、TaylorSeer [ 19 ] 和 Cache-DiT [ 20 ] 等方法利用了时间冗余性。 这些减少步数的技术与我们的两阶段调度相互独立；虽然缓存减少了固定分辨率轨迹内的计算量，但我们的调度则改变了分辨率轨迹本身。

paragraphs.en: Throughout this report, we lean heavily on a fundamental distinction in inference optimization: methods that preserve the generation contract versus methods that alter the schedule or the step count. Techniques such as operator fusion (discussed in Sec. 3.5 ), exact attention backends, and lossless collective layouts provide like-for-like runtime speedups without changing the output. Conversely, schedule modifications produce a fundamentally different artifact. While these two categories of optimization compose effectively in practice, they must not be conflated when reporting speedups, as evaluating a different generation contract is not equivalent to accelerating a fixed one.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个报告中，我们主要依赖推理优化中的一个基本区别：那些保留生成契约的方法与那些改变调度或步数方法之间的差异。 诸如算子融合（见第 3.5 节）、精确注意力后端和无损集体布局等技术，能够在不改变输出的情况下实现同等的运行时加速效果。 相反，对调度的修改会产生一个本质不同的结果。 尽管这两类优化在实践中可以很好地结合使用，但在报告加速效果时，绝不能将它们混为一谈，因为评估一个不同的生成契约并不等同于加速一个固定的生成契约。

paragraphs.en: The general context for our recursive self-improvement loop is the rapid emergence of agentic coding and machine-learning experimentation systems. Frameworks such as SWE-agent [ 63 ] , AutoCodeRover [ 64 ] , Agentless [ 65 ] , and OpenHands [ 66 ] automate software engineering tasks, while benchmarks and systems like AgentBench [ 67 ] , MLAgentBench [ 68 ] , The AI Scientist [ 69 ] , and AI Harness Engineering [ 70 ] explore autonomous research and experimentation. More specifically, this report belongs to the lineage of agents designed to write and optimize GPU kernels. The KernelBench benchmark [ 71 ] demonstrated that frontier models perform this task poorly without iterative feedback. Subsequent systems have addressed this gap: CUDA-LLM [ 72 ] and CudaForge [ 73 ] focus on kernel generation, AccelOpt [ 74 ] introduces a self-improving agentic system that curates an optimization memory of slow-fast kernel pairs, and AlphaEvolve [ 75 ] employs an evolutionary coding agent for algorithmic discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 我们递归式自我改进循环的总体背景是，具备智能体能力的编码和机器学习实验系统正在迅速涌现。 SWE-agent [ 63 ]、AutoCodeRover [ 64 ]、Agentless [ 65 ] 和 OpenHands [ 66 ] 等框架能够自动化软件工程任务，而 AgentBench [ 67 ]、MLAgentBench [ 68 ]、The AI Scientist [ 69 ] 和 AI Harness Engineering [ 70 ] 等基准测试与系统则致力于探索自主研究与实验。 更具体地说，本报告属于专为编写和优化 GPU 内核而设计的智能体系列。 KernelBench 基准测试 [ 71 ] 表明，前沿模型在没有迭代反馈的情况下执行这项任务的效果很差。 后续的系统已针对这一空白进行了改进：CUDA-LLM [ 72 ] 和 CudaForge [ 73 ] 专注于内核生成；AccelOpt [ 74 ] 引入了一种具备自我改进能力的智能体系统，该系统会整理慢速与快速内核对的优化记忆；而 AlphaEvolve [ 75 ] 则采用进化式编码智能体进行算法发现。

paragraphs.en: Our direct predecessor in this domain is the Sol video inference engine [ 34 ] , an agent-native, full-stack acceleration framework. Sol composes caching, sparse attention, token pruning, quantization, and kernel fusion through a hierarchy of specialized skill agents and a central integrator agent. This report represents the deep application of the Sol framework to a single model family, extending the prior work by introducing a strict fail-closed contract as an explicit constraint on the optimization process.
paragraphs.zh: 该领域我们直接的先行者是 Sol 视频推理引擎 [ 34 ]，这是一个面向智能体的全栈加速框架。 Sol 通过分层的专业技能智能体和一个中央集成智能体，将缓存、稀疏注意力、令牌剪枝、量化和内核融合整合在一起。 本报告展示了 Sol 框架在单一模型族上的深度应用，并通过引入一个严格的故障关闭契约作为优化过程的显式约束，扩展了先前的工作。

paragraphs.en: This fail-closed constraint forms a critical positioning argument for our methodology. Unconstrained self-improving agents may inadvertently redefine the task they are optimizing—for instance, by silently reducing step counts or altering the numerical trajectory—which makes their reported performance gains difficult to attribute. Our recursive self-improvement loop is deliberately restricted: it searches realizations of a fixed generation contract (such as numerical formats, kernel boundaries, attention backends, collective layouts, and memory residency) but never alters the contract itself. Consequently, an accepted change is guaranteed to be a like-for-like reduction measured against the same baseline on the same hardware, and a rejected candidate yields a precise measurement rather than an unquantified judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 这种故障容闭约束构成了我们方法论的关键定位依据。 不受约束的自我改进智能体可能无意中重新定义其正在优化的任务——例如，通过静默减少步数或改变数值轨迹——这使得其报告的性能提升难以归因。 我们的递归自我改进循环受到刻意限制：它仅搜索固定生成契约（如数值格式、内核边界、注意力后端、集体布局和内存驻留）的实现，但绝不会改变该契约本身。 因此，一个被接受的变化可保证是相对于同一硬件上的相同基线所进行的同类对比性简化，而被拒绝的候选方案则会提供一个精确的测量结果，而非无法量化的判断。

paragraphs.en: Given the massive computational demands of video generation, cloud environments serve as the primary deployment vehicle. To maximize serving efficiency and reduce the compute cost per generation, we restructure the original single-stage, uniform-resolution denoising process into an asymmetric two-stage generation pipeline. We further apply a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop to iteratively optimize the execution stack. This RSI process systematically eliminates redundancy across each stage, elevating computational efficiency and generation throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于视频生成对计算能力的巨大需求，云环境成为主要部署方案。 为最大化服务效率并降低每次生成的计算成本，我们将原有的单阶段、统一分辨率的去噪流程重构为一种非对称的两阶段生成流程。 我们进一步采用递归自我改进（RSI）循环，以迭代优化执行栈。 这一 RSI 流程系统性地消除了各阶段间的冗余操作，从而提升了计算效率和生成吞吐量。

paragraphs.en: The two stages use independently trained VAEs [ 2 ] , so matching spatial resolution alone does not make their latents interchangeable. H3 represents video with 24 channels and spatial compression of 16 × 16\times , whereas the LTX-2.5 Conv Video VAE uses 128 channels and spatial compression of 32 × 32\times . A direct connection would decode the H3 latent into pixels and re-encode those pixels with the LTX VAE, adding two large networks and their intermediate activations to the handoff. We replace this round trip with a learned latent-to-latent translator. Spatial enlargement remains a separate operation: the learned H3 × 2 \times 2 upscaler first raises the draft resolution, and the translator then maps that representation to LTX at the same pixel resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个阶段使用了独立训练的 VAE [ 2 ]，因此仅匹配空间分辨率并不足以使它们的潜在表示相互替换。 H3 表示具有 24 个通道和 16 × 16\times 空间压缩的视频，而 LTX-2.5 Conv Video VAE 则使用 128 个通道和 32 × 32\times 的空间压缩。 直接连接会将 H3 的潜在表示解码为像素，再用 LTX VAE 重新编码这些像素，从而在交接过程中增加两个大型网络及其中间激活值。 我们用一种经过学习的潜在表示到潜在表示的转换器来替代这种往返过程。 空间放大仍然是一个独立的操作：首先由经过学习的 H3 × 2 \times 2 上采样器提升草稿分辨率，然后由转换器将该表示映射到相同像素分辨率的 LTX。

paragraphs.en: The main alignment difficulty is temporal. H3 encodes independent 17-frame chunks with nominal temporal compression of 4 × 4\times , producing nonuniform token positions across chunk boundaries; LTX uses a causal 8 × 8\times temporal grid. We therefore align tokens by their physical frame positions rather than their tensor indices. A fixed front end concatenates a linearly interpolated H3 feature at each LTX time position with three slots containing the nearest-bin source tokens. Each source token is retained exactly once in the packed slots. A spatial pixel-unshuffle then moves each 2 × 2 2\times 2 neighborhood into channels, producing 24 × ( 1 + 3 ) × 4 = 384 24\times(1+3)\times 4=384 channels on the LTX grid. This parameter-free packing preserves the source features instead of averaging them away before learning the cross-VAE mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 主要对齐困难是时间上的。 H3 对独立的 17 帧片段进行编码，名义上的时间压缩比为 4 × 4\times ，导致片段边界处的 token 位置不统一；LTX 则使用因果性的 8 × 8\times 时间网格。 因此，我们根据 token 的物理帧位置而非张量索引来进行对齐。 一个固定的前端将每个 LTX 时间位置处经线性插值的 H3 特征与包含最近邻源 token 的三个槽位拼接在一起。 每个源 token 在打包后的槽位中仅保留一次。 随后，空间像素重排操作将每个 2 × 2 2\times 2 邻域移至通道中，从而在 LTX 网格上生成 24 × ( 1 + 3 ) × 4 = 384 24\times(1+3)\times 4=384 个通道。 这种无需参数的打包方式保留了源特征，而非在学习跨 VAE 映射前将其平均掉。

paragraphs.en: In a representative full-resolution H3 profile, layout transformations and collectives accumulated 94 ms per denoising step, alongside 341 ms of SDPA attention computation. The 94 ms comprises 42 ms of layout copies and 52 ms of communication. The baseline executes three QKV collectives and one output collective per attention layer. Retaining packed QKV storage combines the three input exchanges into one, reducing the total to two collectives without changing the unquantized payload volume. A flat (total, heads, head_dim) layout also removes the redundant batch dimension at batch size one. However, a naive PyTorch implementation achieved only 0.953 × 0.953\times the reference throughput, a 4.7% reduction: stack followed by a destination-major permute(...).contiguous() copied the activation volume twice before communication. The optimized stride-aware kernels instead read Q, K, and V through their existing strides and write directly into the exchange buffer in one pass. The inverse head merge uses the same approach on the return path. These layout-only kernels are bit-identical to the reference permutations they replace.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个具有代表性的全分辨率 H3 配置中，布局转换和集体操作在每个降噪步骤中累积了 94 毫秒，此外还有 341 毫秒的 SDPA 注意力计算。 这 94 毫秒包括 42 毫秒的布局复制和 52 毫秒的通信时间。 基线版本在每层注意力中执行三次 QKV 集体操作和一次输出集体操作。 保留打包的 QKV 存储可将三次输入交换合并为一次，从而将总次数减少到两次集体操作，同时不改变未量化的数据量。 一种扁平的（总数、头数、头维度）布局还能在批量大小为 1 时移除冗余的批量维度。 然而，一个朴素的 PyTorch 实现仅达到了参考吞吐量的 0.953 × 0.953 倍，即减少了 4.7%：堆叠操作后接一个以目的地为主的 permute(...).contiguous() 在通信前复制了激活数据两次。 相反，经过优化的步长感知内核通过其现有的步长读取 Q、K 和 V，并一次性直接写入交换缓冲区。 反向头合并在返回路径上采用了相同的方法。 这些仅涉及布局变化的内核与它们所替代的参考排列在比特层面完全一致。

paragraphs.en: Under sequence parallelism [ 61 ] , the packed QKV exchange and attention-output return require two all-to-all collectives per attention layer. The block-INT8 QKV format stores one token/head record as 384 quantized value bytes, twelve group-32 finite-positive UE5M3 scale codes, and four zero padding bytes, for 400 bytes in total. We evaluate two distinct output formats. The block-INT8 format stores 128 value bytes and four scale codes, padded from 132 to 144 bytes to align each record to 16 bytes; this aligned format improves the measured NCCL transfer performance on GB200 despite its larger payload. The FP8 alternative instead transmits 128 raw E4M3 bytes per token/head, without separate scale metadata or padding. All transmitted padding bytes are explicitly initialized. Both quantized wire formats are approximate and are validated separately from the bit-exact layout transformations.
paragraphs.zh: 在序列并行性 [ 61 ] 下，打包的 QKV 交换和注意力输出返回需要每层注意力执行两次全对全集体通信操作。 block-INT8 QKV 格式将每个 token/head 的记录存储为 384 个量化值字节、十二个 group-32 有限正 UE5M3 缩放码以及四个零填充字节，总计 400 字节。 我们评估了两种不同的输出格式。 block-INT8 格式存储 128 个值字节和四个缩放码，并通过填充将大小从 132 字节扩展到 144 字节，以使每个记录对齐到 16 字节；尽管这种对齐格式的数据负载更大，但它提升了在 GB200 上测得的 NCCL 传输性能。 相比之下，FP8 替代方案以每个 token/head 传输 128 个原始 E4M3 字节，不包含独立的缩放元数据或填充。 所有传输的填充字节均经过显式初始化。 这两种量化传输格式均为近似表示，并且与位精确的布局转换分开进行验证。

Their end-to-end benefit also depends on the cost of quantization, scale layout conversion, and surrounding data movement. We therefore evaluate the arithmetic kernels together with their producers and communication interfaces.

paragraphs.en: Sol-H3 uses MXFP8 GEMMs for attention and FFN projections in zero-indexed transformer blocks 2–46, inclusive, on the validated SM100-family path [ 54 ] . Weights and activations use E4M3 values with one E8M0 scale for each group of 32 values along the reduction dimension. The scale buffers use the cuBLASLt-compatible SWIZZLE_32_4_4 layout. Fused RMSNorm/modulation and SwiGLU producers write the E4M3 activations and swizzled scales directly, eliminating the intermediate BF16 tensor and a separate quantization pass. Boundary blocks, AdaLN projections, refiners, VAE, and text/audio encoders retain BF16 computation. The quantization is approximate.
paragraphs.zh: Sol-H3 在已验证的 SM100 系列路径 [ 54 ] 中，对第 2 至 46 个（含）零索引的 Transformer 块中的注意力机制和 FFN 投影使用 MXFP8 GEMM。 权重和激活值采用 E4M3 格式，每 32 个值的一组（沿归约维度）使用一个 E8M0 标度因子。 标度缓冲区使用与 cuBLASLt 兼容的 SWIZZLE_32_4_4 布局。 融合 RMSNorm/调制和 SwiGLU 的生产器直接写入 E4M3 激活值和经过重排标度，从而消除了中间 BF16 张量和单独的量化步骤。 边界块、AdaLN 投影、精炼器、VAE 以及文本/音频编码器保留 BF16 计算。 该量化是近似的。

paragraphs.en: Sol-H3 reuses the raw E4M3 values returned by attention as inputs to the quantized output projections, supplying unit E8M0 scales. The receiver merges the rank-major heads directly into the projection’s row-major input, avoiding an intermediate BF16 tensor and subsequent dynamic quantization. Integrating this reuse with the fused activation producers removes redundant data conversions between attention, communication, and linear computation.

paragraphs.en: In the refinement stage, the token count grows substantially with resolution, sharply increasing the computational cost of attention [ 32 , 77 ] . We therefore employ Sol-Attn [ 78 ] , a training-free block-sparse attention method [ 21 , 22 , 43 , 45 ] that uses online thresholding to select a small subset KV blocks for computation. Specifically, for each query block, the threshold is set to μ + τ ​ σ \mu+\tau\sigma , where μ \mu and σ \sigma denote the mean and standard deviation of its block-level attention scores across KV blocks, and τ \tau is a tunable hyperparameter that controls sparsity. Only KV blocks whose scores exceed this threshold are selected for attention computation; a larger τ \tau raises the threshold and thus retains fewer blocks. We observe that sparsification has a greater impact on global image coherence during early, high-noise refinement steps than during later, low-noise steps. We therefore adopt a step-dependent schedule that progressively increases sparsity, setting τ \tau to 1.0 1.0 , 1.25 1.25 , and 1.5 1.5 for the three refinement steps, respectively. To accommodate different GPU architectures, we use cuDNN block-sparse attention (BSA) and a custom CuTe DSL kernel [ 30 ] as alternative backends, improving kernel efficiency and multi-GPU serving performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在细化阶段，随着分辨率的提高，标记数量会显著增长，从而急剧增加注意力机制的计算成本 [ 32 , 77 ] 。 因此，我们采用 Sol-Attn [ 78 ] ，这是一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力方法 [ 21 , 22 , 43 , 45 ] ，通过在线阈值选择少量 KV 块进行计算。 具体而言，对于每个查询块，阈值设为 μ + τ ​ σ \mu+\tau\sigma ，其中 μ \mu 和 σ \sigma 分别表示其跨 KV 块的块级注意力分数的均值和标准差，而 τ \tau 是一个用于控制稀疏度的可调超参数。 只有分数超过该阈值的 KV 块会被选中进行注意力计算；τ \tau 值越大，阈值越高，从而保留的块越少。 我们观察到，在早期高噪声的细化步骤中，稀疏化对全局图像连贯性的影响比后期低噪声步骤更大。 因此，我们采用一种随步骤变化的调度策略，逐步增加稀疏度，分别为三个细化步骤设置 τ \tau 为 1.0 1.0 、1.25 1.25 和 1.5 1.5 。 为了适应不同的 GPU 架构，我们使用 cuDNN 块稀疏注意力（BSA）和自定义的 CuTe DSL 内核 [ 30 ] 作为替代后端，从而提升了内核效率和多 GPU 服务性能。

sents.en: We therefore employ Sol-Attn [ 78 ] , a training-free block-sparse attention method [ 21 , 22 , 43 , 45 ] that uses online thresholding to select a small subset KV blocks for computation.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用 Sol-Attn [ 78 ] ，这是一种无需训练的块稀疏注意力方法 [ 21 , 22 , 43 , 45 ] ，通过在线阈值选择少量 KV 块进行计算。

sents.en: Specifically, for each query block, the threshold is set to μ + τ ​ σ \mu+\tau\sigma , where μ \mu and σ \sigma denote the mean and standard deviation of its block-level attention scores across KV blocks, and τ \tau is a tunable hyperparameter that controls sparsity.
sents.zh: 具体而言，对于每个查询块，阈值设为 μ + τ ​ σ \mu+\tau\sigma ，其中 μ \mu 和 σ \sigma 分别表示其跨 KV 块的块级注意力分数的均值和标准差，而 τ \tau 是一个用于控制稀疏度的可调超参数。

sents.en: Only KV blocks whose scores exceed this threshold are selected for attention computation; a larger τ \tau raises the threshold and thus retains fewer blocks.
sents.zh: 只有分数超过该阈值的 KV 块会被选中进行注意力计算；τ \tau 值越大，阈值越高，从而保留的块越少。

sents.en: We observe that sparsification has a greater impact on global image coherence during early, high-noise refinement steps than during later, low-noise steps.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，在早期高噪声的细化步骤中，稀疏化对全局图像连贯性的影响比后期低噪声步骤更大。

sents.en: We therefore adopt a step-dependent schedule that progressively increases sparsity, setting τ \tau to 1.0 1.0 , 1.25 1.25 , and 1.5 1.5 for the three refinement steps, respectively.
sents.zh: 因此，我们采用一种随步骤变化的调度策略，逐步增加稀疏度，分别为三个细化步骤设置 τ \tau 为 1.0 1.0 、1.25 1.25 和 1.5 1.5 。

sents.en: To accommodate different GPU architectures, we use cuDNN block-sparse attention (BSA) and a custom CuTe DSL kernel [ 30 ] as alternative backends, improving kernel efficiency and multi-GPU serving performance.
sents.zh: 为了适应不同的 GPU 架构，我们使用 cuDNN 块稀疏注意力（BSA）和自定义的 CuTe DSL 内核 [ 30 ] 作为替代后端，从而提升了内核效率和多 GPU 服务性能。

paragraphs.en: In practice, we keep the first two transformer layers dense throughout denoising, as errors introduced while global structure is still forming may persist through subsequent layers. Within the remaining attention layers, we use distinct attention paths for prefix and target-video queries. MiniMax-H3 packs each sequence as [ text ∣ conditioning video ​ ∣ audio ∣ ​ target video ] [\,\texttt{text}\mid\texttt{conditioning video}\mid\texttt{audio}\mid\texttt{target video}\,] , so all tokens preceding the target video form a contiguous prefix. Queries from this prefix attend to all KV tokens through dense cross-attention. The remaining target-video queries use block-sparse attention, with the prefix KV blocks serving as always-attended sinks that are evaluated exactly regardless of the routing threshold. Importantly, this protection covers the entire prefix rather than text tokens alone: the audio tokens are themselves generated, with the model predicting audio velocities at these positions. In validation, we observed severe dialogue degradation even in a case that achieved the highest visual-quality score among the compared variants, highlighting the need to preserve audio fidelity alongside visual quality. This design preserves dense connectivity between the multimodal prefix and the full sequence while retaining block-sparse attention among target-video tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，我们在整个去噪过程中保持前两层 Transformer 为密集连接，因为在全局结构仍在形成时引入的错误可能会延续到后续层中。 在剩余的注意力层中，我们为前缀和目标视频查询使用不同的注意力路径。 MiniMax-H3 将每个序列打包为 [ text ∣ conditioning video ​ ∣ audio ∣ ​ target video ] [\,\texttt{text}\mid\texttt{conditioning video}\mid\texttt{audio}\mid\texttt{target video}\,]，因此目标视频之前的所有令牌构成一个连续的前缀。 来自该前缀的查询通过密集交叉注意力关注所有 KV 令牌。 剩余的目标视频查询使用块稀疏注意力，其中前缀 KV 块始终作为被关注的接收端，无论路由阈值如何都会被精确评估。 重要的是，这种保护覆盖了整个前缀，而不仅仅是文本令牌：音频令牌本身也是生成的，模型会预测这些位置上的音频速度。 在验证过程中，我们观察到即使在一个与对比变体相比获得最高视觉质量分数的案例中，对话质量也出现了严重退化，这凸显了在与视觉质量并行的同时保持音频保真度的必要性。 这种设计在保留目标视频令牌之间的块稀疏注意力的同时，保持了多模态前缀与完整序列之间的密集连接。

paragraphs.en: The DiT [ 3 ] repeatedly writes wide intermediate tensors to HBM and reads them back for subsequent elementwise operations. Fusion reduces this traffic by consuming intermediates in registers. H3 combines RMSNorm, partial rotary embeddings, SwiGLU, and per-row indexed modulation, requiring adaptations to fusion kernels designed for other architectures. The RSI loop searches implementation and launch configurations, profiles their latency, and checks their numerical behavior against the corresponding reference.
paragraphs.zh: DiT [ 3 ] 会反复将宽中间张量写入 HBM，并在后续的元素级操作中将其读回。 融合通过消耗寄存器中的中间结果来减少这种数据流量。 H3 结合了 RMSNorm、部分旋转嵌入、SwiGLU 和每行索引调制，因此需要针对为其他架构设计的融合内核进行适配。 RSI 循环会搜索实现和启动配置，分析其延迟，并检查其数值行为是否与对应的参考结果一致。

paragraphs.en: The RSI loop identifies three operator groups across the 50 H3 transformer blocks: (1) residual addition with indexed gating, RMSNorm, and indexed scale/shift modulation; (2) QK normalization with partial RoPE; and (3) SwiGLU splitting, SiLU, and multiplication. At a representative four-rank context-parallel shape of 9562 local rows and hidden width 5376, these fusions reduce repeated reads and writes of wide intermediate tensors. Pure layout transformations are bit-identical to their reference permutations. Arithmetic fusions preserve the operator structure, but changes in intermediate precision and floating-point rounding can prevent bitwise equivalence to the original eager implementation; we distinguish these from the separately validated LoRA consumer-fusion equivalence below.
paragraphs.zh: RSI 循环在 50 个 H3 变压器块中识别出三个算子组：(1) 带索引门控的残差加法、RMSNorm 和带索引的缩放/偏移调制；(2) 部分 RoPE 的 QK 归一化；以及 (3) SwiGLU 拆分、SiLU 和乘法。 在一个具有 9562 个本地行和 5376 隐藏宽度的典型四秩上下文并行形状中，这些融合减少了宽中间张量的重复读取和写入。 纯粹的布局变换与参考排列在位级别上完全相同。 算术融合保留了算子结构，但中间精度的变化和浮点舍入可能导致其与原始即时实现无法在位级别上等价；我们在下文将这些情况与已单独验证的 LoRA 消费者-融合等价性区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We instead retain the base and LoRA branches and fuse their addition into the next consumer kernel. Each projection still executes the same three GEMMs with unchanged weights and reduction order. The fused consumer explicitly rounds base + δ \mathrm{base}+\delta to BF16 before QK normalization, RoPE and packing, residual modulation, or SwiGLU; the final FFN consumer also retains the intermediate BF16 gate product. Preserving these rounding points removes the wide sum’s HBM write/read pair while retaining the separate-branch arithmetic. The implementation specializes to one active adapter at unit scale with BF16 linear compute, independent of the adapter’s name. Its numerical agreement and runtime are evaluated against native branches with the other acceleration settings held constant in Sec. 6.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而保留基础分支和 LoRA 分支，并将它们的加法融合到下一个消费者内核中。 每个投影仍然执行相同的三个 GEMM 操作，且权重和归约顺序保持不变。 融合后的消费者在 QK 归一化、RoPE、打包、残差调制或 SwiGLU 之前，会显式地将 base + δ \mathrm{base}+\delta 四舍五入到 BF16；最终的 FFN 消费者也会保留中间阶段的 BF16 门产物。 保留这些四舍五入点可以消除宽和的 HBM 写入/读取对，同时保持分支独立的算术运算。 该实现专门针对单位规模下的单个活跃适配器进行优化，并使用 BF16 线性计算，与适配器的名称无关。 其数值一致性和运行时性能将在第 6.6 节中与原生分支进行比较评估，其他加速设置保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Context parallelism shards the transformer stack but does not by itself partition video decoding. In the evaluated H3 configuration, each rank would otherwise decode the full video. At 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 and 124 output frames, the H3 decoder processes seven temporal clips with 28 equal-sized spatial tiles per clip, for 196 tile decodes. Distributing these independent tiles over eight ranks reduces the recorded decode latency from 7.55 s to approximately 1.16 s while retaining the original stitch order.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文并行性将 Transformer 堆栈进行了分片，但本身并不会对视频解码进行分区。 在评估的 H3 配置中，每个秩原本需要解码完整的视频。 在 1344 × 768 和 124 个输出帧的情况下，H3 解码器处理七个时间片段，每个片段包含 28 个大小相等的空间分块，共计 196 次分块解码。 将这些独立分块分配给八个秩，可将记录下来的解码延迟从 7.55 秒缩短至约 1.16 秒，同时保持原有的拼接顺序。

paragraphs.en: Sharding leaves four tile slots per rank in each temporal clip. Decoding these four tiles as one local batch, rather than launching the decoder separately for each tile, reduces latency from 1.1597 s to 0.6021 s, a 1.93 × 1.93\times speedup in the recorded configuration. paragraphs.en: While cloud environments serve as the primary deployment vehicle due to massive computational demands, there is substantial demand for executing these generative models locally or on edge devices. To enable efficient local deployment, we undertake a comprehensive set of optimizations targeting strict reductions in both latency and device memory footprint. The binding constraint in this regime is device memory residency. It requires the entire working set, including the text encoder, drafting model, refiner, and VAE, must remain simultaneously resident in HBM. If the working set does not fit, the runtime must offload weights to host memory and stream them back on demand, incurring a substantial host-device communication cost that dominates request latency.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管云环境因巨大的计算需求而成为主要部署方式，但在本地或边缘设备上执行这些生成模型的需求也非常显著。 为了实现高效的本地部署，我们开展了一系列全面的优化工作，旨在严格降低延迟和设备内存占用。 在此机制下，关键约束是设备内存的驻留性。 这要求整个工作集（包括文本编码器、起草模型、精炼器和 VAE）必须同时驻留在 HBM 中。 如果工作集无法完全容纳，运行时就必须将权重卸载到主机内存中，并在需要时重新加载，这会带来巨大的主机-设备通信开销，从而主导请求延迟。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we detail the specific optimization techniques applied to achieve these latency and memory objectives, focusing on strategies such as deterministic modulation caching, prompt caching, and weight quantization. Ultimately, deploying this optimized pipeline on a single-accelerator edge environment, such as a GB10, successfully fits the complete generative stack onto the device while delivering highly responsive local inference.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们详细说明了为实现这些延迟和内存目标而采用的具体优化技术，重点包括确定性调制缓存、提示缓存和权重量化等策略。 最终，将这一优化后的流程部署到单加速器边缘环境中（例如 GB10），成功地将完整的生成堆栈适配到该设备上，同时实现了高度响应的本地推理。

paragraphs.en: For MiniMax-H3, approximately 13B of the model’s 33B parameters reside in the adaln_proj module. At inference time, this module recomputes the modulation table at every denoising step, amounting to 2500 recomputations per generated video. Because the projection’s only input is the timestep embedding, and that embedding depends solely on the sampling schedule fixed before the denoising loop, every one of those recomputations produces a value that was already knowable in advance. Consequently, this repetition is pure redundancy, with the module imposing waste along two dimensions: device memory is consumed because the wide projection weights must stay resident, and compute and bandwidth are expended regenerating the same table at each step. Our runtime precomputes the entire table once and maintains a cache indexed by (block, step). This eliminates two severe bottlenecks. First, it saves about 24 GB of device memory, as replacing the 26 GB of adaln_proj weights with a precomputed table of ≈ 1.5 \approx 1.5 GB lowers denoiser residency from 61.7 GB to ≈ 37 \approx 37 GB. Second, it eliminates about 26 GB of HBM reads per step; the reference pipeline streams 520 MB of weight data across HBM per block to produce just nine output rows, incurring a bandwidth tax with minimal arithmetic intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 MiniMax-H3，该模型 33B 个参数中约有 13B 个位于 adaln_proj 模块中。 在推理阶段，该模块会在每个去噪步骤中重新计算调制表，每生成一个视频就需要进行 2500 次重新计算。 由于该投影的唯一输入是时间步嵌入，而该嵌入仅取决于去噪循环之前就已固定的采样计划，因此每次重新计算都会产生一个原本就可以提前得知的值。 因此，这种重复完全是多余的：该模块在两个维度上造成了资源浪费——由于宽投影权重必须常驻内存，设备内存被占用；同时，每一步都需要重新生成相同的表，从而消耗了计算资源和带宽。 我们的运行时方案会预先计算整个表一次，并维护一个以（块，步）为索引的缓存。 这消除了两个严重的性能瓶颈。 首先，它节省了约 24 GB 的设备内存：用约 1.5 GB 的预计算表替换 26 GB 的 adaln_proj 权重后，去噪器的常驻内存从 61.7 GB 降至约 37 GB。 其次，它消除了每一步约 26 GB 的 HBM 读取操作；参考流程每块需要流式传输 520 MB 的权重数据穿越 HBM，仅为了生成九行输出，这带来了高昂的带宽开销，而计算强度却极低。

paragraphs.en: As established in Sec. 3.1 , Stage 1 has already fixed the global layout, semantic content, and motion of the generated video. The role of Stage 2 is mainly local high-frequency refinement. Therefore, Stage 2 does not require per-sample text conditioning: the sample-specific information it needs is already carried by the Stage-1 latent it receives, and a generic, prompt-independent conditioning signal suffices.

paragraphs.en: Instead of encoding the user’s prompt dynamically for Stage 2, we evaluate a single canonical generic refinement prompt once and offline, 4K, refined, high quality, cinematic detail, clean textures, natural motion . Consequently, neither the Stage-2 text encoder nor its connector is ever loaded during online inference, freeing the 16.2 GiB for other modules.
paragraphs.zh: 在阶段 2 中，我们不采用动态编码用户提示的方式，而是预先一次性评估一个标准的通用优化提示：4K、优化后、高质量、电影级细节、干净纹理、自然运动。 该提示通过 INT8 Gemma 文本编码器和 INT8 开发连接器进行处理，我们仅保留经过连接器处理后的紧凑视频和音频上下文张量，作为缓存输入到阶段 2。 因此，在线推理过程中既不会加载阶段 2 的文本编码器，也不会加载其连接器，从而释放出 16.2 GiB 的空间供其他模块使用。

paragraphs.en: For deployment on a single DGX Spark (GB10), quantization is essential to keeping the two-stage pipeline resident within the device’s 119.68 GiB CPU–GPU unified memory pool. The edge configuration pairs an FP8 H3 draft DiT [ 54 ] with an NVFP4 AWQ Qwen prompt encoder [ 53 , 54 , 76 , 36 ] , with reported resident footprints of 23.4 GiB and 14.6 GiB, respectively. The runtime reads each layer’s quantization configuration from the checkpoint, allowing different projections to use different precision settings. Qwen encodes each incoming prompt during online inference. The INT8 Gemma encoder and connector are used only offline to construct the cached Stage-2 conditioning described in Sec. 4.2 , and neither remains resident during request processing.

paragraphs.en: In many practical deployment scenarios, generation is conditioned on user-provided reference materials. In this reference-to-video and audio (ref2av) setting, the model synthesizes output video and audio based on a set of conditioning reference images or videos. As the volume of reference materials data grows, the interaction between reference tokens and generation tokens becomes a struggler of generation latency. Thus, we propose a reference token caching strategy to further reduce latency in this setting [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在许多实际部署场景中，生成过程会基于用户提供的参考材料进行条件约束。 在这种“参考到视频和音频”（ref2av）的设置中，模型会根据一组作为条件的参考图像或视频来合成输出视频和音频。 随着参考材料数据量的增长，参考标记与生成标记之间的交互会成为影响生成延迟的关键问题。 因此，我们提出了一种参考标记缓存策略，以进一步降低这种设置下的延迟 [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Reference computation redundancy. During the standard diffusion inference process, the model executes N N denoising steps. In a naive implementation, every self-attention evaluation across these N N steps recomputes the reference tokens in full, with no computations skipped. However, unlike the target video tokens which are iteratively denoised, the reference latent fed into the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) [ 3 ] is a clean latent. Because no noise is added to the reference inputs, their representations vary only weakly with the timestep embedding [ 16 , 19 ] . Consequently, recomputing the full self-attention for the reference tokens at every denoising step introduces potential computational redundancy.
paragraphs.zh: 参考计算的冗余性。 在标准的扩散推理过程中，模型会执行 N 次去噪步骤。 在一种简单的实现中，这 N 次步骤中的每一次自注意力评估都会完整重新计算参考标记，没有任何计算被跳过。 然而，与迭代去噪的目标视频标记不同，输入到扩散变换器（DiT）[3] 的参考潜在变量是一个干净的潜在变量。 由于没有噪声被添加到参考输入中，它们的表示仅随时间步嵌入 [16, 19] 发生微弱变化。 因此，在每次去噪步骤中都重新计算参考标记的全部自注意力，可能会引入计算冗余。

paragraphs.en: . To eliminate this inefficiency, we introduce a reference KV caching mechanism. The core principle is to evaluate the reference branch in full only during the first DiT step. During this initial step, the key (K) and value (V) tensors for the reference tokens are computed and cached. For all subsequent denoising steps, the reference tokens are no longer recomputed; instead, their cached KV tensors are retained and reused unchanged (the cached KV is never iterated or refreshed). The subsequent steps only evaluate the generated tokens, which attend to the cached reference KV. Because the first step remains a full computation, the conditioning signal is established exactly, and only the redundant repetitions in later steps are bypassed.
paragraphs.zh: . 为了解决这种低效问题，我们引入了一种参考 KV 缓存机制。 其核心原则是：仅在第一个 DiT 步骤中完整评估参考分支。 在此初始步骤中，参考标记的键（K）和值（V）张量会被计算并缓存。 在所有后续的去噪步骤中，参考标记不再被重新计算；相反，其缓存的 KV 张量会被保留并原样复用（缓存的 KV 绝不会被迭代或刷新）。 后续步骤仅评估生成的标记，这些标记会关注已缓存的参考 KV。 由于第一步仍然是完整的计算过程，因此条件信号能够被精确建立，只有后续步骤中的冗余重复部分被绕过。

paragraphs.en: We note that this caching strategy is an approximation rather than a bitwise-identical transformation. Although the input reference latent is clean, its intermediate representations naturally drift slightly across steps due to the changing timestep embeddings in the DiT blocks. However, from the qualitative comparison, we find that the faithful recomputation pipeline and caching pipeline show minor deviation, demonstrating that the caching strategy is a practical approximation method for reference to video generation especially when reference material is heavy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们注意到，这种缓存策略是一种近似方法，而非逐位完全相同的转换。 尽管输入的参考潜在变量是干净的，但由于 DiT 块中时间步嵌入的变化，其中间表示在各步骤间自然会出现轻微漂移。 然而，通过定性比较我们发现，忠实重计算流程与缓存流程仅存在微小偏差，这表明该缓存策略是一种实用的近似方法，尤其适用于参考材料较多的视频生成场景。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the two-stage cross-resolution pipeline results measured on a single NVIDIA GB200. For a 5 s workload at 1344 × \times 768 resolution, the pipeline achieves an end-to-end latency of 6.852 s, comprising 4.173 s for Stage 1 and 2.679 s for Stage 2. This represents a 22.2 × \times speedup over the SGLang [ 60 ] baseline of 152.3 s [ 35 ] . For a 10 s workload at the same 1344 × \times 768 resolution, the end-to-end latency is 14.931 s (9.820 s for Stage 1 and 5.111 s for Stage 2), yielding a 27.7 × \times speedup over the SGLang baseline of 414.1 s.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单台 NVIDIA GB200 上测量并评估了该两阶段跨分辨率流水线的结果。 对于分辨率为 1344 × 768、持续时间为 5 秒的工作负载，该流水线的端到端延迟为 6.852 秒，其中第一阶段耗时 4.173 秒，第二阶段耗时 2.679 秒。 与 SGLang [ 60 ] 基准方法（152.3 秒 [ 35 ] ）相比，这实现了 22.2 倍的速度提升。 对于相同分辨率（1344 × 768）下持续时间为 10 秒的工作负载，端到端延迟为 14.931 秒（其中第一阶段耗时 9.820 秒，第二阶段耗时 5.111 秒），相比 SGLang 基准方法（414.1 秒）实现了 27.7 倍的速度提升。

paragraphs.en: The same two-stage pipeline also runs on a single consumer GPU. On one RTX 5090 the 5 s 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 request completes in 39.80 s, against a 1045.40 s full-resolution 49-step baseline measured on the same card, a 26.3 × \times speedup. The latency composition differs from both datacenter and DGX Spark deployments: Qwen prompt encoding is the single largest block at 34.1%, ahead of H3 4-step generation at 28.2% and LTX 3-step refinement at 19.7%, with LTX VAE decode at 5.1% and the upscaler and latent adapter at 2.8%. The text encoder dominates not because encoding is expensive but because the encoder is rebuilt for every request: of the 13.568 s attributed to this block, the NVFP4 AWQ Qwen forward pass accounts for 0.518 s and the rest is loading and teardown [ 53 ] . Unlike a one-time startup cost, this is charged on each request, because the 5090 cannot hold the encoder in GPU HBM together with both generation stages and therefore runs under CPU offload. Denoising itself is therefore no longer the limiting term on consumer hardware; prompt-encoder residency is, which is the same pressure the Stage-2 conditioning cache in Sec. 4.2 relieves on DGX Spark.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Sol-H3 on one, four, and eight NVIDIA GB200 GPUs [ 79 , 80 ] at 1344 × \times 768 resolution and 24 FPS, generating reference-free video with stereo audio. All nine combinations of GPU count and output duration use the same prompt, seed 20260903, and merged four-step LoRA [ 81 , 11 , 12 , 14 ] . paragraphs.en: Reference conditioning substantially increases computation overhead. paragraphs.en: Although the caching strategy is an approximation method instead of a lossless system optimization, the qualitative comparison demonstrates that this approximation only introduces minor perceptual differences. paragraphs.en: We evaluate 120 text-to-video-and-audio (T2VA) tasks and 120 reference-to-video-and-audio (Ref2VA) tasks, spanning diverse subjects, visual styles, actions, and camera movements. Candidates are grouped by task type and number of function evaluations (NFE), with four and six candidates for T2VA at 4 and 8 NFE, respectively, and two and three candidates for Ref2VA. Exhaustive within-group pairing for every task yields 3,000 pairwise comparisons: 720, 1,800, 120, and 360 in these four groups. In addition to the adapters discussed below, the T2VA pool includes FastH3 Preview v1 LoRA [ 82 ] at 4 NFE and the FastH3 V2 full distilled-checkpoint baseline [ 83 ] at 8 NFE. For each task, the compared runs use the frozen rewritten prompt, reference assets, and the same initial video/audio noise.

paragraphs.en: We combine human assessment on a subset of pairs with VLM assessment of the full 3,000-pair pool, keeping the two sources of judgments separate. Both protocols hide model identities, randomize the A/B presentation, and allow ties. Human raters can play the generated videos with audio and provide an overall preference. For the visual-only VLM assessment, Astra with high reasoning effort receives the generation instruction, 16 uniformly sampled frames from each candidate video, and the available visual reference material; reference videos are likewise sampled into 16 frames. No audio is supplied or scored, and audio-related prompt requirements are excluded from its judgment. Each pair receives one VLM judgment in a fresh context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将人类对部分成对样本的评估与 VLM 对整个 3000 个成对样本池的评估相结合，同时保持这两种判断来源相互独立。 两种方案均隐藏模型身份、随机呈现 A/B 选项，并允许出现平局。 人类评分员可以播放包含音频的生成视频，并提供整体偏好评价。 在仅基于视觉的 VLM 评估中，具备高推理能力的 Astra 会收到生成指令、每个候选视频中均匀采样的 16 帧画面以及可用的视觉参考材料；参考视频同样会被采样为 16 帧。 不提供也不对音频进行评分，且与音频相关的提示要求不会被纳入其判断范围。 每对样本都会在新的上下文中获得一次 VLM 判断。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the adapter separately from the two-stage generator to isolate conversion cost and reconstruction fidelity. The quality evaluation uses 256 held-out test videos, disjoint from training, development, and earlier evaluation cohorts. Both the predicted latent and the paired LTX teacher latent are decoded with the same frozen Conv Video VAE. We report mean per-video PSNR over the decoded clips and SSIM over 16 uniformly sampled frames. These metrics measure agreement with the LTX reconstruction of the source video, before any Stage-2 denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将适配器与两阶段生成器分开评估，以区分转换成本与重建保真度。 质量评估使用了 256 段预留的测试视频，这些视频与训练集、开发集及早期评估数据集互不重叠。 预测的潜在表示和配对的 LTX 教师潜在表示均通过相同的冻结 Conv Video VAE 进行解码。 我们报告了解码片段上的每视频平均 PSNR，以及从 16 个均匀采样的帧中计算的 SSIM。 这些指标衡量的是与源视频的 LTX 重建结果的一致性，且未进行任何阶段 2 的去噪处理。

paragraphs.en: In this report, we present Sol-H3, a full-stack efficient inference pipeline for the MiniMax-H3 video-audio generator. By combining a cross-resolution two-stage generation pipeline with a kernel-level optimization stack discovered via Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), Sol-H3 achieves unprecedented generation speeds across both cloud and edge environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Sol-H3——一个面向 MiniMax-H3 视频音频生成器的全栈高效推理流程。 通过将跨分辨率的两阶段生成流程与通过递归自我改进（RSI）发现的内核级优化堆栈相结合，Sol-H3 在云端和边缘环境中均实现了前所未有的生成速度。

sents.en: In this report, we present Sol-H3, a full-stack efficient inference pipeline for the MiniMax-H3 video-audio generator.
sents.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Sol-H3——一个面向 MiniMax-H3 视频音频生成器的全栈高效推理流程。

sents.en: By combining a cross-resolution two-stage generation pipeline with a kernel-level optimization stack discovered via Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), Sol-H3 achieves unprecedented generation speeds across both cloud and edge environments.
sents.zh: 通过将跨分辨率的两阶段生成流程与通过递归自我改进（RSI）发现的内核级优化堆栈相结合，Sol-H3 在云端和边缘环境中均实现了前所未有的生成速度。

paragraphs.en: A key takeaway from the development of Sol-H3 is the complementary relationship between human architectural insight and automated optimization. In our work, the macro-level inference framework is fundamentally driven by human design, whereas the micro-level implementation optimizations are systematically executed by the RSI loop.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Sol-H3 的开发中得出的一个关键结论是，人类建筑洞察与自动化优化之间存在互补关系。 在我们的工作中，宏观层面的推理框架根本上由人类设计驱动，而微观层面的实现优化则由 RSI 循环系统性地执行。

sents.zh: 从 Sol-H3 的开发中得出的一个关键结论是，人类建筑洞察与自动化优化之间存在互补关系。

paragraphs.en: Communication collectives and quantization: Jointly searching the configuration space of data compression and network transfer to eliminate distributed inference bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 通信集体与量化：联合搜索数据压缩和网络传输的配置空间，以消除分布式推理的瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Fusion kernel implementation: Automatically discovering and generating optimal operator groupings to minimize redundant HBM traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 融合内核实现：自动发现并生成最优算子组合，以最小化冗余的 HBM 流量。

paragraphs.en: Sparse attention implementation: Engineering highly efficient, hardware-aware attention mechanisms to manage massive sequence lengths.
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏注意力实现：设计高效且适配硬件的注意力机制，以处理超长序列。

paragraphs.en: Precision-preserving LoRA integration: Ensuring that low-rank adaptation operations are accelerated without compromising numerical fidelity or generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 保精度的 LoRA 集成：确保低秩适配操作在加速的同时，不损害数值保真度或生成质量。

paragraphs.en: The cross-resolution two-stage framework: Conceptualizing the overarching algorithmic strategy to exploit the step-wise nature of diffusion models, balancing early global layout generation with later high-resolution refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 跨分辨率两阶段框架：构想一种全局性的算法策略，以利用扩散模型的逐步特性，在早期生成全局布局与后期进行高分辨率细化之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: The latent adapter: Recognizing the system-level trade-offs of standard VAE decoders/encoders, and designing a custom adapter to efficiently bridge the coarse-to-fine generation stages at the cost of strict scene-identity invariance.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在适配器：认识到标准 VAE 解码器/编码器在系统层面上的权衡，并设计一种定制适配器，以严格的场景身份不变性为代价，高效地连接粗粒度到细粒度的生成阶段。

paragraphs.en: Based on this dichotomy, we observe that RSI is exceptionally well-suited for systematically resolving deterministic, well-bounded engineering problems where success can be mathematically verified against a baseline. However, for open-ended, architectural pipeline designs that necessitate lossy approximations or holistic trade-offs, human engineering remains indispensable. Ultimately, this synergy of human algorithmic design and RSI-driven kernel optimization enables faster-than-real-time high-resolution video synthesis, drastically lowering the barrier to deploying massive video generation models in production.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这种二分法，我们观察到 RSI 非常适合系统性地解决确定性且边界明确的工程问题，在这些问题中，成功与否可以通过数学方法对照基准进行验证。 然而，对于需要无损近似的开放型架构流程设计或整体权衡决策的情况而言，人类工程能力仍然是不可或缺的。 最终，人类算法设计与 RSI 驱动的核心优化之间的协同作用，使得超实时高分辨率视频合成成为可能，从而大幅降低了将大规模视频生成模型部署到生产环境中的门槛。

sents.en: Based on this dichotomy, we observe that RSI is exceptionally well-suited for systematically resolving deterministic, well-bounded engineering problems where success can be mathematically verified against a baseline.
sents.zh: 基于这种二分法，我们观察到 RSI 非常适合系统性地解决确定性且边界明确的工程问题，在这些问题中，成功与否可以通过数学方法对照基准进行验证。

sents.en: However, for open-ended, architectural pipeline designs that necessitate lossy approximations or holistic trade-offs, human engineering remains indispensable.
sents.zh: 然而，对于需要无损近似的开放型架构流程设计或整体权衡决策的情况而言，人类工程能力仍然是不可或缺的。

sents.en: Ultimately, this synergy of human algorithmic design and RSI-driven kernel optimization enables faster-than-real-time high-resolution video synthesis, drastically lowering the barrier to deploying massive video generation models in production.
sents.zh: 最终，人类算法设计与 RSI 驱动的核心优化之间的协同作用，使得超实时高分辨率视频合成成为可能，从而大幅降低了将大规模视频生成模型部署到生产环境中的门槛。

paragraphs.en: The source corpus contains 80,000 videos stored in eight archives. Each source video is resized identically before encoding with the frozen H3 and LTX-2.5 Conv VAEs. We use deterministic posterior modes and the released per-channel normalization statistics. For a 192-frame clip at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 , the H3 tensor has shape 24 × 57 × 48 × 84 24\times 57\times 48\times 84 in channel–time–height–width order. LTX pads the input to 193 frames and produces 128 × 25 × 24 × 42 128\times 25\times 24\times 42 . H3 token positions follow the 17-frame chunking rule, with anchors 0 , 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 , 17 , 21 , … 0,4,8,12,16,17,21,\ldots and the configured removal of three trailing tokens. The fixed alignment in Sec. 3.1 yields 384 × 25 × 24 × 42 384\times 25\times 24\times 42 features, retaining each H3 token in one of three temporal slots before spatial pixel-unshuffle. The skip projection maps these features to 128 channels and remains fixed after ridge-regression initialization; the residual network is trained end to end.
paragraphs.zh: 源语料库包含存储在八个存档中的 80,000 个视频。 每个源视频在通过冻结的 H3 和 LTX-2.5 Conv VAE 编码之前，都会以相同方式调整大小。 我们使用确定性后验模式以及已发布的每通道归一化统计信息。 对于分辨率为 1344 × 768 的 192 帧片段，H3 张量的形状为 24 × 57 × 48 × 84（按通道–时间–高度–宽度顺序排列）。 LTX 将输入填充至 193 帧，并生成形状为 128 × 25 × 24 × 42 的输出。 H3 的标记位置遵循 17 帧分块规则，锚点为 0、4、8、12、16、17、21……，并配置了移除最后三个标记的规则。 第 3.1 节中的固定对齐方式生成了 384 × 25 × 24 × 42 的特征，在空间像素重排之前，将每个 H3 标记保留在三个时间槽之一中。 跳过投影将这些特征映射到 128 个通道，并在岭回归初始化后保持固定；残差网络则进行端到端训练。

paragraphs.en: The final decoder-aware optimization starts from an earlier trained adapter and uses 65,536 cached video pairs at native resolution. Two phases of 2,500 and 5,000 updates use global batch size 32, for 240,000 additional sample presentations. Each phase uses AdamW with peak learning rate 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , zero weight decay, and gradient clipping at 1.0. The respective warmup lengths are 100 and 150 updates, followed by cosine decay to 5% of the peak learning rate; the second phase restarts the optimizer from the first phase’s weights. Training uses BF16 autocast and activation checkpointing through the residual stack and the frozen decoder. The objective in Eq. 1 is evaluated on the full spatial grid, with decoded-video supervision weight α = 160 \alpha=160 . Only the adapter’s residual path is updated; the affine skip and both VAEs remain fixed. The reported final checkpoint uses the trained weights directly, without EMA averaging.

paragraphs.en: Sample identifiers are assigned to train, validation, and test partitions by a stable hash with a 98/1/1 split. The final development and test cohorts contain 256 videos each and exclude identifiers used in earlier evaluation cohorts. Checkpoint selection uses development data. In the final evaluator, predictions and teacher reconstructions are clamped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and compared over their common decoded temporal extent, including the VAE padding rather than an explicit crop back to 192 frames. PSNR is computed per video and then averaged across videos; SSIM uses 16 uniformly sampled decoded frames. Motion quartiles are defined by temporal differences in the teacher latents. Paired confidence intervals use 10,000 bootstrap resamples over the same clip identifiers. These reconstruction measurements do not evaluate prompt adherence, audio quality, or the output of subsequent LTX refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 通过稳定的哈希函数为训练、验证和测试分区分配样本标识符，其比例为 98/1/1。 最终的开发和测试组各包含 256 个视频，且排除了早期评估组中使用的标识符。 检查点的选择使用开发数据。 在最终评估器中，预测结果和教师模型的重建结果被限制在 [0, 1] 范围内，并在它们共同的解码时间范围上进行比较，该范围包括 VAE 填充部分，而非显式地裁剪回 192 帧。 PSNR 按视频计算，然后在所有视频上取平均值；SSIM 使用 16 个均匀采样的解码帧。 运动四分位数由教师模型潜在表示中的时间差异定义。 成对置信区间基于相同剪辑标识符的 10,000 次自助重采样计算得出。 这些重建测量指标不评估提示遵循性、音频质量或后续 LTX 优化步骤的输出结果。

paragraphs.en: The merge diagnostic fixes the checkpoint, prompt, initial noise and sampling schedule, and compares the first denoising evaluation on four GB200 GPUs with the other runtime optimizations disabled. With linear computation held in FP32, merging into BF16 weights gives 35.26% relative RMSE in the video prediction against the original separate-branch baseline; retaining the merged weights in FP32 reduces this to 6.24%. FP32 GEMMs alone therefore do not recover updates already lost during weight storage. Changing the separate branches themselves to FP32 gives 6.08% relative RMSE against the same baseline, showing why higher precision is also insufficient to reproduce the original mixed-precision computation exactly. These are prediction discrepancies for one input at one denoising evaluation, not perceptual-quality scores. The six-projection counts in Sec. 3.5 use FP32 reconstructions of W + B ​ A W+BA and count nonzero entries of B ​ A BA for which casting the sum to BF16 returns the original W W entry.
paragraphs.zh: 合并诊断修复了检查点、提示、初始噪声和采样计划，并在禁用其他运行时优化的情况下，将首次去噪评估在四块 GB200 GPU 上的结果与其他情况进行比较。 在线性计算保持为 FP32 的情况下，合并为 BF16 权重使得视频预测的相对 RMSE 相较于原始分离分支基线降低了 35.26%；若将合并后的权重保留为 FP32，则此值降至 6.24%。 因此，仅使用 FP32 GEMM 无法恢复在权重存储过程中已经丢失的更新。 将分离分支本身改为 FP32，与同一基线相比可获得 6.08% 的相对 RMSE，这表明为何更高的精度也无法完全重现原始的混合精度计算。 这些是单次输入在一次去噪评估中的预测差异，而非感知质量分数。 第 3.5 节中的六投影计数使用了 W + B ​ A W+BA 的 FP32 重建结果，并统计 B ​ A BA 中非零项的数量，其中将总和转换为 BF16 后仍能返回原始的 W W 项。

paragraphs.en: The released implementation 1 1 1 NVlabs/Sana PR #503 , commit 51b14fd6f262 . accepts the supported public PEFT LoRA [ 81 ] and FastVideo v2 hybrid formats. Hybrid .diff / .diff_b corrections are applied to the base parameters with FP32 accumulation before conversion to the parameter dtype; low-rank factors remain separate. Consumer fusion requires inference mode, one active scale-1 adapter, ordinary BF16 linear layers, identity LoRA dropout, and no projection hooks. Unsupported installation configurations are rejected before consumer patches are installed; unsupported runtime states fall back to native PEFT. QKV consumer fusion uses the multi-GPU Ulysses path, while single-GPU dense Q/K/V projections and projections outside the main transformer blocks retain native execution.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的实现 1 1 1 NVlabs/Sana PR #503，提交 51b14fd6f262，支持公共 PEFT LoRA [81] 和 FastVideo v2 混合格式。 混合 .diff / .diff_b 修正在转换为参数 dtype 之前，会基于 FP32 累加应用于基础参数；低秩因子则保持独立。 消费者融合需要推理模式、一个激活的 scale-1 适配器、普通的 BF16 线性层、恒等 LoRA dropout，且不能有投影钩子。 在安装消费者补丁之前，不支持的安装配置将被拒绝；不支持的运行时状态将回退到原生 PEFT。 QKV 消费者融合使用多 GPU 的 Ulysses 路径，而单 GPU 的密集 Q/K/V 投影以及主 transformer 块之外的投影则保留原生执行方式。

sents.zh: 混合 .diff / .diff_b 修正在转换为参数 dtype 之前，会基于 FP32 累加应用于基础参数；低秩因子则保持独立。

sents.en: Consumer fusion requires inference mode, one active scale-1 adapter, ordinary BF16 linear layers, identity LoRA dropout, and no projection hooks.
sents.zh: 消费者融合需要推理模式、一个激活的 scale-1 适配器、普通的 BF16 线性层、恒等 LoRA dropout，且不能有投影钩子。

sents.en: Unsupported installation configurations are rejected before consumer patches are installed; unsupported runtime states fall back to native PEFT.
sents.zh: 在安装消费者补丁之前，不支持的安装配置将被拒绝；不支持的运行时状态将回退到原生 PEFT。

sents.en: QKV consumer fusion uses the multi-GPU Ulysses path, while single-GPU dense Q/K/V projections and projections outside the main transformer blocks retain native execution.
sents.zh: QKV 消费者融合使用多 GPU 的 Ulysses 路径，而单 GPU 的密集 Q/K/V 投影以及主 transformer 块之外的投影则保留原生执行方式。

paragraphs.en: The public runtime defaults to merged . The separate and fused modes retain LoRA branches and require compute-quant=none ; the latter enables the consumer kernels. This disables quantized linear compute, not the independent attention or communication optimizations. The controlled comparison in Tab. 5 explicitly selects each mode; enabling consumer fusion is not implicit in every pipeline measurement. The released regression suite covers BF16 rounding boundaries, non-contiguous inputs, indexed gates, promoted-dtype fallback, BF16/INT8 QKV packing, and row addressing beyond 2 31 2^{31} elements. Full-pipeline byte agreement remains scoped to the tested inputs and their recorded GPU and software configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 公共运行时默认采用合并模式。 分离模式和融合模式会保留 LoRA 分支，并要求 compute-quant=none；后者会启用消费者内核。 这会禁用量化线性计算，但不会影响独立的注意力或通信优化。 表 5 中的受控比较明确选择了每种模式；并非所有管道测量都隐式启用了消费者融合。 发布的回归测试套件涵盖了 BF16 舍入边界、非连续输入、索引门、提升数据类型的回退机制、BF16/INT8 QKV 打包，以及超过 2^{31} 个元素的行寻址。 完整管道的字节级一致性仍局限于所测试的输入及其记录下来的 GPU 和软件配置。

sents.en: The public runtime defaults to merged .
sents.zh: 公共运行时默认采用合并模式。

sents.en: The separate and fused modes retain LoRA branches and require compute-quant=none ; the latter enables the consumer kernels.
sents.zh: 分离模式和融合模式会保留 LoRA 分支，并要求 compute-quant=none；后者会启用消费者内核。

sents.en: This disables quantized linear compute, not the independent attention or communication optimizations.
sents.zh: 这会禁用量化线性计算，但不会影响独立的注意力或通信优化。

sents.en: The controlled comparison in Tab. 5 explicitly selects each mode; enabling consumer fusion is not implicit in every pipeline measurement.
sents.zh: 表 5 中的受控比较明确选择了每种模式；并非所有管道测量都隐式启用了消费者融合。

sents.en: The released regression suite covers BF16 rounding boundaries, non-contiguous inputs, indexed gates, promoted-dtype fallback, BF16/INT8 QKV packing, and row addressing beyond 2 31 2^{31} elements.
sents.zh: 发布的回归测试套件涵盖了 BF16 舍入边界、非连续输入、索引门、提升数据类型的回退机制、BF16/INT8 QKV 打包，以及超过 2^{31} 个元素的行寻址。

sents.en: Full-pipeline byte agreement remains scoped to the tested inputs and their recorded GPU and software configurations.
sents.zh: 完整管道的字节级一致性仍局限于所测试的输入及其记录下来的 GPU 和软件配置。

paragraphs.en: The additional rerun in Fig. 8 uses seed 42, eight denoising evaluations, four GB200 GPUs, and 362 frames at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 and 24 FPS. Each arm performs its natural random draws and verifies the resulting tensors and generator states against the same stored reference before replay; initial conditioning and the video/audio sampling grids are also checked. The native and fused arms match in every recorded prediction and in the complete decoded video and audio. We export all frames directly to lossless 8-bit RGB PNGs before MP4 encoding and compare their pixel hashes. The full-frame rows use common zero-based indices 180 and 300. The 480 × 320 480\times 320 detail crops instead follow the butterfly burst at the explicitly labeled times, because merging changes its timing as well as its appearance. These audited runs include tensor hashing and frame export and are separate from the warm latency measurements in Tab. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 中的额外重跑使用种子 42、八次去噪评估、四块 GB200 GPU，以及以 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 和 24 FPS 运行的 362 帧。 每个分支执行其自然的随机抽取，并在重播前将生成的张量和生成器状态与相同的存储参考进行验证；初始条件以及视频/音频采样网格也会一并检查。 原生分支与融合分支在所有记录下来的预测结果以及完整的解码视频和音频中均完全一致。 在 MP4 编码之前，我们将所有帧直接导出为无损 8-bit RGB PNG 文件，并比较它们的像素哈希值。 全帧行使用共同的基于零的索引 180 和 300。 而 480 × 320 480\times 320 的细节裁剪则遵循明确标记时间点的蝴蝶式爆发，因为合并操作会改变其时序和外观。 这些经过审计的运行包含张量哈希和帧导出，且与表 5 中的暖机延迟测量数据相互独立。

sents.en: The additional rerun in Fig. 8 uses seed 42, eight denoising evaluations, four GB200 GPUs, and 362 frames at 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 and 24 FPS.
sents.zh: 图 8 中的额外重跑使用种子 42、八次去噪评估、四块 GB200 GPU，以及以 1344 × 768 1344\times 768 和 24 FPS 运行的 362 帧。

sents.en: Each arm performs its natural random draws and verifies the resulting tensors and generator states against the same stored reference before replay; initial conditioning and the video/audio sampling grids are also checked.
sents.zh: 每个分支执行其自然的随机抽取，并在重播前将生成的张量和生成器状态与相同的存储参考进行验证；初始条件以及视频/音频采样网格也会一并检查。

sents.en: The native and fused arms match in every recorded prediction and in the complete decoded video and audio.
sents.zh: 原生分支与融合分支在所有记录下来的预测结果以及完整的解码视频和音频中均完全一致。

sents.en: We export all frames directly to lossless 8-bit RGB PNGs before MP4 encoding and compare their pixel hashes.
sents.zh: 在 MP4 编码之前，我们将所有帧直接导出为无损 8-bit RGB PNG 文件，并比较它们的像素哈希值。

sents.en: The full-frame rows use common zero-based indices 180 and 300.
sents.zh: 全帧行使用共同的基于零的索引 180 和 300。

sents.en: The 480 × 320 480\times 320 detail crops instead follow the butterfly burst at the explicitly labeled times, because merging changes its timing as well as its appearance.
sents.zh: 而 480 × 320 480\times 320 的细节裁剪则遵循明确标记时间点的蝴蝶式爆发，因为合并操作会改变其时序和外观。

sents.en: These audited runs include tensor hashing and frame export and are separate from the warm latency measurements in Tab. 5 .
sents.zh: 这些经过审计的运行包含张量哈希和帧导出，且与表 5 中的暖机延迟测量数据相互独立。
